source: Solana-native DeFi exploits only. Curated from Rekt, public post-mortems, and protocol disclosures. Excludes cross-chain hacks where the root cause sat outside Solana (e.g. Kelp/rsETH via LayerZero). Excludes centralised exchange compromises, Telegram bot wallet-level incidents, and prevented exploits (Jet whitehat).

hacks.recoveryNote: Jump Crypto replaced the 120k ETH within 24 hours, averting ecosystem-wide cascade to all Solana protocols holding wETH
